       let owner = owner.trim();\n        if owner.is_empty() {\n            return Ok(PlayCampaignDocumentRead::UnknownCampaign);\n        }\n        if include_dm_notes && decode_sql_text(owner)? != actor {\n            return Ok(PlayCampaignDocumentRead::Forbidden);\n        }\n        let row = self.sql(&format!(\n            \"SELECT hex(story),hex(dm_notes) FROM play_campaign_documents WHERE   };\n        if fields.next().is_some() {\n            return Err(());\n        }\n        Ok(PlayCampaignDocumentRead::Found(document))\n    }\n\n    fn play_campaign_export_owner(&self,       sql_text(campaign_id)\n        ))?;\n        let campaign_owner = campaign_owner.trim();\n        if campaign_owner.is_empty() {\n            return   };\n        if fields.next().is_some() {\n            return Err(());\n        }\n        Ok(PlayCampaignDocumentRead::Found(document))\n    }\n\n    fn play_campaign_export_owner(&self,
